question: Does independent repeated-tail consensus repair phase36 false witness vetoes while abstaining on unstable or length-changing encodings?
hypothesis: A single injective permutation acts on the first unit of line-initial words, leaving tails and supplied boundaries unchanged. Output is normalization to a base cipher alphabet, not plaintext.
development: Phase36 known cases used openly, not counted as new evidence. First majority-consensus version produced 10/12 allography and identity successes, zero errors, versus 3/12 previously. Adding repeated split-source evidence left these results unchanged. No other parameter search performed.

passages.claim: Six disjoint fresh passage triples from previously used works; not fresh authors. Families and layouts share passages, not 84 independent texts.

normalization: Same pinned Gutenberg bytes and NFKD a-z tokenization as phase36. Eight words per line or greedy width42, retaining original layout after ciphering.
seeds: 370000+100*condition+family_index; condition=4*author_index+2*block+layout_index. Generated only after freeze. Solver receives no family, seed, key, plaintext or source work.
controls: First five families unchanged from phase36. mixed_key chooses an alternative deranged-relative key with probability0.25 at each line start in all three stages. random_initial replaces the first unit uniformly from a-z on every line in all stages. Both are outside the stable-key model and must abstain completely.
fit_rule: Words3..12units; line-initial vs strictly interior; exact tail after first unit. An anchor requires singleton observed first-symbol sets in both roles and >=2 occurrences per role. Distinct tails vote once each. Candidate needs>=3 agreeing tails and>=80percent of all its votes. Remove all candidates sharing a target; no greedy tie breaking.
witness_rule: Same consensus fitted independently to separate witness, anchor minimum1 per role and>=3 tails,>=80percent. Retain only pairs identical to fit. An independently supported different target for any fit source vetoes entire map. At least3 retained pairs and>=25percent witness first-word coverage required.
split_rule: In either fit or witness, reject entire map if one pair of initial symbols each occurs>=2 times with each of>=3 distinct shared tails, while each corresponding interior tail has a single observed initial symbol repeated>=2 times. Possible lexical confound remains; calibration tests this diagnostic rather than presuming word identity.
prediction: Only authorized sources normalized at line starts; all other words explicitly abstain. Freeze fit/witness bytes before predicting transfer, then read answers only after both proposed and baseline predictions are saved. No update from transfer.
case_success: At least3 authorized pairs,100 emitted first words,25percent transfer coverage; zero wrong emitted words and zero invalid authorized pairs.
gate: At least10/12 allography successes,>=3/4 each author,>=10/12 identity successes; zero wrong emitted words or invalid authorized pairs in all84 cases; complete abstention on all12 cases of EACH changed_key,prefix,mixed_key,random_initial. Nonce may pass; that supplies no semantic evidence.
baseline: Frozen phase36 model run on exactly the same84 cases, only as a paired comparator. New larger fitting and witness passages preclude attributing all improvements to code using cross-phase raw counts.
manuscript_if_gate_passes: Only if the complete gate passes: apply fixed model to archived phase23 ZL and IT records; exclude labels, paragraph-initial @, interruptions <-> or <~>, nonzero segments, f85/f86, unknown Currier A/B or hand. Group Currier and attributed hand, physical-folio SHA256 mod3 fixes fit/witness/transfer. Require100 line-initial records each fold. Both literal EVA and phase23 greedy atoms. Save IDs, mappings, abstentions and independent transfer recheck, never phonetics or translation.
historical_exposure: All manuscript pages already exposed. Copied files read for integrity hashes before gate, no pre-gate fitting or prediction. Same operator owns generation and checking; function-argument separation is not OS or human blinding.
stop: A single gate violation prevents manuscript inference. No post-result threshold changes. Do not claim failed detection refutes allography or proves no message.
verification: Separate mathematical implementation of anchors, consensus, split diagnostic and normalization; reconstruct every ciphertext from pinned sources and seeded keys; byte-identical replay; manifest and ZIP verification.
publication: Local only; no push, deployment or external messages.
